fullPassage:
What Is Your Personal Color?

The colors you wear are important in creating an attractive appearance. People can learn which color clothes are suitable for them by identifying their personal color, a color that perfectly fits their individual skin tone. To figure out the most desirable color scheme for your clothing, you must first determine if the underlying color in your skin tone is warm or cool. Try holding an object with a certain color up to your face in a mirror and decide which color makes you look best. If your face looks best with colors of pink, purple, or blue, you have a cool skin tone. If your face looks best with warm colors such as yellow, orange, or red, your skin tone is warm. Generally you will look best with clothes of similar tones to your personal color. If a color causes your face to look dull, avoid that color in your collection of clothes.

questions.passage: What Is Your Personal Color? The colors you wear are important in creating an (A)[attractive / unattractive] appearance. People can learn which color clothes are (B)[suitable / unsuitable] for them by identifying their personal color, a color that perfectly fits their (C)[individual / identical] skin tone. To figure out the most desirable color scheme for your clothing, you must first determine if the underlying color in your skin tone is warm or cool. Try holding an object with a certain color up to your face in a mirror and decide which color makes you look best. If your face looks best with colors of pink, purple, or blue, you have a cool skin tone.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① unattractive — suitable — individual: unattractive는 attractive의 반의어
✅ ② attractive — suitable — individual: 원문 그대로 ←정답
❌ ③ attractive — unsuitable — individual: unsuitable은 suitable의 반의어
❌ ④ attractive — suitable — identical: identical은 individual과 혼동
det.tip: attractive(매력적인) ↔ unattractive, suitable(적합한) ↔ unsuitable, individual(개인의) ↔ identical(동일한)

questions.passage: The colors you wear are important in creating an attractive appearance. People can learn which color clothes are suitable for them by identifying their personal color, a color that perfectly fits their individual skin tone. To figure out the most (A)[desirable / undesirable] color scheme for your clothing, you must first (B)[determine / undermine] if the underlying color in your skin tone is warm or cool. Try holding an object with a certain color up to your face in a mirror and (C)[decide / decline] which color makes you look best. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① desirable — determine — decide: 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② undesirable(바람직하지 않은): desirable의 반의어
❌ ③ desirable — undermine(약화시키다): determine과 혼동
❌ ④ desirable — determine — decline(거절하다): decide의 혼동어
det.tip: desirable(바람직한) ↔ undesirable, determine(결정하다) ↔ undermine(약화시키다), decide(결정하다) ↔ decline(거절하다)

questions.passage: Try holding an object with a certain color up to your face in a mirror and decide which color makes you look best. If your face looks best with colors of pink, purple, or blue, you have a cool skin tone. If your face looks best with warm colors such as yellow, orange, or red, your skin tone is warm. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 자신의 퍼스널 컬러와 비슷한(similar) 톤의 옷이 가장 잘 어울린다. 어떤 색이 얼굴을 칙칙하게(dull) 보이게 한다면(causes), 그 색을 피하라.
det.analysis:
✅ ② similar — causes — dull: 원문 일치
❌ ① different(다른): similar(비슷한)의 반의어
❌ ③ prevents(방지하다): causes(야기하다)의 반의어
❌ ④ vivid(선명한): dull(칙칙한)의 반의어
det.tip: similar(비슷한) ↔ different, causes(야기하다) ↔ prevents(방지하다), dull(칙칙한) ↔ vivid(선명한)

det.analysis:
✅ ④ surface(표면의)는 원문 underlying(근본적인)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ① attractive(매력적인): 원문 적절
❌ ② suitable(적합한): 원문 적절
❌ ③ desirable(바람직한): 원문 적절

det.analysis:

✅ ③ bright(밝은): 원문 dull(칙칙한)의 반의어로 부적절 ←정답

questions.passage:
What Is Your Personal Color?

The colors you wear are important in creating an attractive appearance. People can learn which color clothes are suitable for them by identifying their personal color, a color that perfectly fits their individual skin tone. To figure out the most desirable color scheme for your clothing, you must first determine if the underlying color in your skin tone is warm or cool. Try holding an object with a certain color up to your face in a ____ and decide which color makes you look best. If your face looks best with colors of pink, purple, or blue, you have a cool skin tone. If your face looks best with warm colors such as yellow, orange, or red, your skin tone is warm. Generally you will look best with clothes of similar tones to your personal color. If a color causes your face to look dull, avoid that color in your collection of clothes.
